name: Ammunition (Crossbow): Bolt(s), Fire
body:
Cost 50 gp Weight 0.1 lb.

On a successful hit, fire bolts deal normal damage plus 1d4 points of fire damage. Alchemical fire bolts do not cause any splash damage, and the fire burst isn’t enough to ignite targets (unless they are particularly flammable).
